english.note: Use this when the thing is bright because it is giving off light.
Use 光 as the all-purpose adjective for a room or place that is bright rather than dark.
Use 光 for something that is visibly shining or giving off a lot of light.

examples.english: The moon is shiny and lights up the night.
examples.jyutping: jyut6 loeng6 hai2 je6 hung1 zung1 faat3 gwong1

examples.english: The room is so light that we don't need to turn on the light.
examples.jyutping: gaan1 fong2 gam3 gwong1 m4 sai2 hoi1 dang1

examples.english: The lamp is so brilliant that I can’t see the TV clearly.
examples.traditional: 枱上盞燈咁光，我睇唔清電視。
examples.jyutping: toi4 soeng6 zaan2 dang1 gam3 gwong1 ngo5 tai2 m4 cing1 din6 si6
